verses.text: E happen say, when Jesus don finish all dis words, e talk say to im disciples,
“Una know say after two days di Passover dey come, and dem go hand Son of Man over make dem crucify am.”
Den di chief priests, di scribes, and di elders of di people gather together for di court of di high priest, wey dem dey call Caiaphas.
Dem take counsel together say dem go take Jesus by deceit, and kill am.
But dem talk say, “No for di feast, so that riot no go happen among di people.”
Now when Jesus dey Bethany, for di house of Simon di leper,
woman come to am wey get alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and e pour am on im head, as e dey sit for di table.
But when im disciples see dis, dem dey indignant, dey talk say, “Why dis waste?”
“Because dem for sell dis ointment for plenty money, and give am to di poor.”
Jesus know dis, and talk say to dem, “Why una dey trouble di woman? Because e don do good work for me.”
“Because una dey always get di poor with una; but una no dey always get me.”
“Because as e pour dis ointment on my body, e do am to prepare me for burial.”
“Most certainly I tell una, wherever dem go preach dis Good News for di whole world, wetin dis woman do go also dey spoken of as memorial of am.”
Den one of di 12, wey dem dey call Judas Iscariot, leave go to di chief priests,
and talk say, “Wetin una dey willing to give me, so that I go hand am over to una?” Dem weigh 30 pieces of silver for am.
From dat time e dey seek opportunity to betray am.
Now for di first day of unleavened bread, di disciples come to Jesus, and talk say to am, “Wia you want make we prepare for you to eat di Passover?”
E talk say, “Go enter di city to one person, and tell am, ‘Di Teacher talk say: My time don near. I go keep di Passover for your house with my disciples.’”
Di disciples do as Jesus command dem, and dem prepare di Passover.
Now when evening don come, e dey recline for di table with di 12 disciples.
As dem dey eat, e talk say, “Most certainly I tell una say one of una go betray me.”
Dem dey very sorrowful, and each begin to ask am, “E no be me, Lord?”
E answer, “Di one wey dip im hand with me for di dish, na im go betray me.”
“Son of Man dey go, even as dem write about am, but woe dey for dat man wey dem go betray Son of Man through! E for better for dat man if dem no born am.”
Judas, wey betray am, answer, “E no be me, Rabbi?” E talk say to am, “You don talk am.”
As dem dey eat, Jesus take bread, give thanks for am, and break am. E give di disciples, and talk say, “Take, eat; dis na my body.”
E take di cup, give thanks, and give dem, and talk say, “All of una drink am,”
“because dis na my blood of di new covenant, wey dem pour out for plenty for di forgiveness of sins.”
“But I tell una say I no go drink dis fruit of di vine from now on, until dat day when I go drink am new with una for my Papa God Kingdom.”
When dem don sing hymn, dem leave go di Mount of Olives.
Den Jesus talk say to dem, “All of una go stumble because of me tonight, because dem write am, ‘I go strike di shepherd, and di sheep of di flock go scatter.’”
“But after dem don raise me up, I go go before una enter Galilee.”
But Peter answer am, “Even if all go stumble because of you, I no go ever stumble.”
Jesus talk say to am, “Most certainly I tell you say tonight, before di rooster crow, you go deny me three times.”
Peter talk say to am, “Even if I must die with you, I no go deny you.” All di disciples talk di same thing too.
Den Jesus come with dem go one place wey dem dey call Gethsemane, and talk say to im disciples, “Sit here, while I go over to dat place to pray.”
E take Peter and di two sons of Zebedee with am, and begin to dey sorrowful and severely troubled.
Den e talk say to dem, “My soul dey very sorrowful, even reach death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
E go forward small, fall on im face, and pray, and talk say, “My Papa God, if e possible, make dis cup pass from me; but no wetin I want, but wetin you want.”
E come to di disciples, and find dem dey sleep, and talk say to Peter, “Wetin, una no fit watch with me for one hour?”
“Watch and pray, so that una no go enter temptation. Di spirit dey willing true, but di flesh dey weak.”
Again, di second time e go away, and pray, and talk say, “My Papa God, if dis cup no fit pass from me unless I drink am, make your desire dey done.”
E come again and find dem dey sleep, because dem eyes dey heavy.
E leave dem again, go away, and pray di third time, dey talk di same words.
Den e come to im disciples, and talk say to dem, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. Look, di hour don near, and dem dey betray Son of Man enter di hands of sinners.”
“Rise, make we dey go. Look, di one wey dey betray me don near.”
While e still dey talk, look, Judas, one of di 12, come, and with am great multitude with swords and clubs, from di chief priests and elders of di people.
Now di one wey betray am give dem sign, and talk say, “Whoever I kiss, na im be di one. Seize am.”
Immediately e come to Jesus, and talk say, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kiss am.
Jesus talk say to am, “Friend, why you dey here?” Den dem come and lay hands on Jesus, and take am.
Look, one of dem wey dey with Jesus stretch out im hand, and draw im sword, and strike di servant of di high priest, and cut off im ear.
Den Jesus talk say to am, “Put your sword back for im place, because all dem wey take sword go die by sword.”
“Or you think say I no fit ask my Papa God, and e go even now send me more pass 12 legions of angels?”
“Den how di Scriptures go fulfill, say e must be so?”
For dat hour Jesus talk say to di multitudes, “Una come out like una dey go against robber, with swords and clubs to seize me? I dey sit daily for di temple dey teach, and una no arrest me.”
“But all dis happen so that di Scriptures of di prophets go fulfill.” Den all di disciples leave am, and run.
Dem wey take Jesus lead am go Caiaphas, di high priest, wia di scribes and di elders dey gather together.
But Peter follow am from far away, reach di court of di high priest, and enter, and sit with di officers, to see di end.
Now di chief priests, di elders, and di whole council seek false testimony against Jesus, so that dem go put am to death;
and dem no find any. Even though plenty false witnesses come forward, dem no find any. But afterward two false witnesses come forward,
and talk say, “Dis man talk say, ‘I fit destroy di temple of God, and build am for three days.’”
Di high priest stand up, and talk say to am, “You no get answer? Wetin be dis wey dem dey testify against you?”
But Jesus keep quiet. Di high priest answer am, “I put you under oath by di living God, say you tell us whether you na Christ, God Pikin.”
Jesus talk say to am, “You don talk am. But I tell una, after dis una go see Son of Man dey sit for di right hand of Power, and dey come on di clouds of di sky.”
Den di high priest tear im clothes, and talk say, “E don talk blasphemy! Why we still need more witnesses? Look, now una don hear im blasphemy.”
“Wetin una think?” Dem answer, “E worthy of death!”
Den dem spit for im face and beat am with dem fists, and some slap am,
and talk say, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
Now Peter dey sit outside for di court, and one maid come to am, and talk say, “You too dey with Jesus, di Galilean!”
But e deny am before dem all, and talk say, “I no know wetin you dey talk.”
When e don go out for di porch, another person see am, and talk say to dem wey dey for dat place, “Dis man too dey with Jesus of Nazareth.”
Again e deny am with oath, “I no know di man.”
After small time dem wey stand near come and talk say to Peter, “Surely you too na one of dem, because your speech dey make dem know you.”
Den e begin to curse and to swear, “I no know di man!” Immediately di rooster crow.
Peter remember di word wey Jesus talk to am, “Before di rooster crow, you go deny me three times.” E leave and weep bitterly.
Now when morning don come, all di chief priests and di elders of di people take counsel against Jesus to put am to death:
and dem bind am, and lead am away, and hand am over to Pontius Pilate, di governor.
Den Judas, wey betray am, when e see say dem don condemn Jesus, e feel remorse, and bring back di 30 pieces of silver to di chief priests and elders,
and talk say, “I don sin because I betray innocent blood.” But dem talk say, “Wetin dat one concern us? You see to am.”
E throw down di pieces of silver for di sanctuary, and leave. E leave go hang imself.
Di chief priests take di pieces of silver, and talk say, “E no lawful to put dem for di treasury, because na di price of blood.”
Dem take counsel, and buy di potter field with dem, to bury strangers.
So dat field dem dey call “Di Field of Blood” reach today.
Den wetin dem talk through Jeremiah di prophet dey fulfilled, and e talk say, “Dem take di 30 pieces of silver, di price of di one wey dem price, wey some of Israel pikin dem price,”
“and dem give dem for di potter field, as di Lord command me.”
Now Jesus stand before di governor: and di governor ask am, “You na King of di Jews?” Jesus talk say to am, “Na so you talk.”
When di chief priests and elders accuse am, e answer nothing.
Den Pilate talk say to am, “You no hear how many things dem dey testify against you?”
E give am no answer, even one word, so tay di governor marvel well.
Now for di feast di governor dey accustomed to release one prisoner to di multitude, whom dem desire.
Dem get notable prisoner dat time, wey dem dey call Barabbas.
So when dem gather together, Pilate talk say to dem, “Who una want make I release to una? Barabbas, or Jesus wey dem dey call Christ?”
Because e know say na because of envy dem hand am over.
While e dey sit for di judgment seat, im wife send to am, and talk say, “Make you no get anything to do with dat righteous man, because I don suffer plenty things today for dream because of am.”
Now di chief priests and di elders persuade di multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
But di governor answer dem, “Which of di two una want make I release to una?” Dem talk say, “Barabbas!”
Pilate talk say to dem, “Wetin den I go do to Jesus, wey dem dey call Christ?” Dem all talk say to am, “Make dem crucify am!”
But di governor talk say, “Why? Wetin evil e don do?” But dem cry out very loud, dey talk say, “Make dem crucify am!”

So when Pilate see say nothing dey gain, but say disturbance dey start, e take water, and wash im hands before di multitude, and talk say, “I innocent of di blood of dis righteous person. Una see to am.”
All di people answer, “Make im blood dey on us, and on our pikin dem!”
Den e release Barabbas to dem, but Jesus e flog and hand over to dem crucify.
Den di governor soldiers take Jesus enter di Praetorium, and gather di whole garrison together against am.
Dem strip am, and put scarlet robe on am.
Dem braid crown of thorns and put am on im head, and reed for im right hand; and dem kneel down before am, and mock am, and talk say, “Hail, King of di Jews!”
Dem spit on am, and take di reed and strike am for di head.
When dem don mock am, dem take di robe off am, and put im clothes on am, and lead am away to crucify am.
As dem dey come out, dem find man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and dem force am to go with dem, so that e go carry im cross.
Dem come to one place wey dem dey call “Golgotha,” wey mean “Di place of skull,”
dem give am vinegar to drink wey dem mix with gall. When e don taste am, e no want drink.
When dem don crucify am, dem divide im clothes among dem, dey cast lots,
and dem sit and dey watch am for dat place.
Dem set up over im head di accusation against am wey dem write, “DIS NA JESUS, DI KING OF DI JEWS.”
Den two robbers dem crucify with am, one for im right hand and one for di left.
Dem wey dey pass by blaspheme am, dey shake dem heads,
and dey talk say, “You wey destroy di temple, and build am for three days, save yourself! If you na God Pikin, come down from di cross!”
Likewise di chief priests too dey mock, with di scribes, di Pharisees, and di elders, and talk say,
“E save others, but e no fit save imself. If e na di King of Israel, make e come down from di cross now, and we go believe inside am.”
“E trust God. Make God save am now, if e want am; because e talk say, ‘I na God Pikin.’”
Di robbers wey dem crucify with am too throw di same reproach on am.
Now from di sixth hour darkness dey over all di land until di ninth hour.
About di ninth hour Jesus cry with loud voice, and talk say, “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?” Dat one mean, “My God, my God, why you don forsake me?”
Some of dem wey dey stand for dat place, when dem hear am, talk say, “Dis man dey call Elijah.”
Immediately one of dem run, and take sponge, and fill am with vinegar, and put am on reed, and give am drink.
Di rest talk say, “Leave am. Make we see whether Elijah go come save am.”
Jesus cry again with loud voice, and give up im spirit.
Look, di veil of di temple tear in two from di top reach di bottom. Di earth shake and di rocks split.
Di tombs open, and plenty bodies of di saints wey don fall asleep rise up;
and as dem dey come out from di tombs after im resurrection, dem enter di holy city and appear to plenty people.
Now di centurion, and dem wey dey with am dey watch Jesus, when dem see di earthquake and di things wey happen, dem fear well, dey talk say, “Truly dis one na God Pikin.”
Plenty women dey for dat place dey watch from far, wey don follow Jesus from Galilee, dey serve am.
Among dem na Mary Magdalene, Mary di mama of James and Joses, and di mama of di sons of Zebedee.
When evening don come, rich man from Arimathaea, wey dem call Joseph, wey imself na Jesus disciple too, come.
Dis man go to Pilate, and ask for Jesus body. Den Pilate command say make dem give di body.
Joseph take di body, and wrap am for clean linen cloth,
and lay am for im own new tomb, wey e don cut out for di rock, and e roll great stone to di door of di tomb, and leave.
Mary Magdalene dey for dat place, and di other Mary, dey sit opposite di tomb.
Now for di next day, wey na di day after di Preparation Day, di chief priests and di Pharisees gather to Pilate,
and talk say, “Oga, we remember wetin dat deceiver talk while e still dey alive: ‘After three days I go rise again.’”

“So command say make dem make di tomb secure until di third day, so that im disciples no go come for night and steal am away, and tell di people, ‘E don rise from di dead;’ and di last deception go worse pass di first.”
Pilate talk say to dem, “Una get guard. Go, make am secure as una fit.”
So dem go with di guard and make di tomb secure, dey seal di stone.
Now after di Sabbath, as e begin to dawn for di first day of di week, Mary Magdalene and di other Mary come to see di tomb.
Look, great earthquake dey, because angel of di Lord descend from di sky, and come and roll away di stone from di door, and sit on am.
Im appearance dey like lightning, and im clothing white like snow.
Because of fear of am, di guards shake, and become like dead men.
Di angel answer di women, “No fear, because I know say una dey seek Jesus, wey dem don crucify.”
“E no dey here, because e don rise, just as e talk. Come, see di place wia di Lord lie.”
“Go quick and tell im disciples, ‘E don rise from di dead, and look, e dey go before una enter Galilee; una go see am for dat place.’ Look, I don tell una.”
Dem leave di tomb quick with fear and great joy, and run to bring im disciples word.
As dem dey go tell im disciples, look, Jesus meet dem, and talk say, “Rejoice!” Dem come and hold im feet, and worship am.
Den Jesus talk say to dem, “No fear. Go tell my brothers say make dem go enter Galilee, and for dat place dem go see me.”
Now while dem dey go, look, some of di guards come enter di city, and tell di chief priests all di things wey happen.
When dem gather with di elders, and take counsel, dem give plenty silver to di soldiers,
and talk say, “Talk say im disciples come for night, and steal am away while we dey sleep.”
“If dis reach di governor ears, we go persuade am and make una free of worry.”
So dem take di money and do as dem tell dem. Dis saying spread among di Jews, and e dey continue until today.
But di 11 disciples go Galilee, to di mountain wia Jesus command dem.
When dem see am, dem worship am, but some doubt.
Jesus come to dem and talk to dem, and talk say, “Dem don give me all authority for heaven and for earth.”
“Go and make disciples of all nations, dey baptize dem for di name of Papa God and of di Pikin and of Holy Spirit,”
“dey teach dem to observe all things wey I command una. Look, I dey with una always, even reach di end of di age.” Amen.
